records.subject: MIGraphXOnnxWorkflow.GetRegisteredOperators
records.nativeOwnership: borrows process-lifetime registry strings only during each C call
records.managedOwnership: owns an Array.AsReadOnly snapshot of independently decoded System.String values
records.threadSafety: the fixed upstream registry is initialized once; managed code detects size drift and does not claim cross-version order stability
records.disposeBehavior: not disposable because no native handle or pointer is retained
records.failureCleanup: partial arrays remain local and are never returned after size, index, null-pointer, UTF-8, or drift failure
records.afterOwnerDispose: not applicable; the returned snapshot is independent of native resource owners

records.subject: MIGraphXArgument.HasSameNativeContent
records.nativeOwnership: borrows two owned argument handles under their owner locks for one native comparison
records.managedOwnership: retains both host-backed buffers and transfers no ownership
records.threadSafety: owner ids impose one total lock order, including reverse calls and same-object comparison
records.disposeBehavior: Dispose waits for an active comparison; a comparison starting after disposal throws ObjectDisposedException
records.failureCleanup: the one-byte bool slot is always freed; native status and invalid bool values fail closed
records.afterOwnerDispose: comparison throws ObjectDisposedException for either disposed argument

records.subject: MIGraphXProgram.HasSameNativeContent
records.nativeOwnership: borrows two owned program handles under their owner locks for one native comparison
records.managedOwnership: retains both managed program instances and transfers no ownership
records.threadSafety: owner ids impose one total lock order, including reverse calls and same-object comparison
records.disposeBehavior: Dispose waits for an active comparison; a comparison starting after disposal throws ObjectDisposedException
records.failureCleanup: the one-byte bool slot is always freed; native status and invalid bool values fail closed
records.afterOwnerDispose: comparison throws ObjectDisposedException for either disposed program

records.subject: MIGraphXShape equality decision
records.nativeOwnership: none; the managed shape retains no migraphx_shape_t
records.managedOwnership: immutable copied static or dynamic metadata remains the complete supported contract
records.threadSafety: immutable managed snapshots remain safe for concurrent reads
records.disposeBehavior: not disposable and unchanged by M10
records.failureCleanup: no temporary native materialization is introduced
records.afterOwnerDispose: shape snapshots remain valid independently of the native collection that produced them
